missing_predecessor_and_access_gaps: Nine PDFs have no exact URL or digest predecessor in this pinned manifest: IFGC, IPC, ISPSC, IEBC, IPMC, LUC Articles 6 and 7, and the two council meeting packets. Absence is scoped to this file/commit and exact comparison.

Original adopting/amending Ordinance 055 and 166 PDFs remain unreceived according to the backlog; the two OrdRes captures are viewer shells, and their exact viewer URLs have no historical record here. Meeting packets are separately labeled proxies, not substituted certified ordinances.
The Building-Code and Land-Use-Code URLs have prior downloaded HTML records. Current 403 shells and WebFetch text exports do not reproduce those original HTML bytes.
The Poudre Fire adoption URL has a historical downloaded HTML digest, but current delivered captures are blocked responses. No historical-source-byte recovery or ownership resolution occurred.

The exact fee-page, public-notices, and two unopened Municode URLs have no matching requested/final URL record in this pinned manifest. This does not imply that no related codes, earlier versions, or fees were ever collected.
limitations: A matching newly computed digest equals the digest recorded in the historical manifest; the historical Windows PDF/HTML bytes were not opened or directly compared. No claim is made that those bytes exist nowhere else.

The local files are delivered source evidence. Network acquisition, retrieval timing and upstream URL attribution remain reporter/log claims, not independently witnessed HTTP transactions in this audit.
Matching bytes do not prove current law, complete amendment chains, effective dates, publisher originality for WebFetch exports, jurisdictional applicability or legal accuracy.
No exact URL/digest match is not evidence of never-collected content. Different URLs, alternate encodings/versions, unrecorded captures, other manifests and archive gaps remain possible.
Pinned-versus-HEAD comparisons cover the named Git blobs at the recorded HEAD commit. They do not certify unrelated files or later commits.
No full legal-content or transcription review was performed, and no repository or delivered-source file was modified.
